name: security_master
title: Security master — one row per stable security identifier

fields.name: sec_id
fields.description: Opaque immutable surrogate. Never reused. The join key everywhere.

fields.name: legal_name
fields.description: Current legal/display name (renames keep the same sec_id).

fields.name: list_date
fields.description: First trading date on TADAWUL (ISO). Basis for age_years.

fields.name: delist_date
fields.description: Last trading date; null if still listed.

fields.name: terminal_value
fields.description: Final per-share value realized at delisting, in SAR (for forward-return labeling). Required when delist_date is set.

fields.name: succeeds_sec_id
fields.description: Predecessor sec_id for merger/spin-off lineage; null otherwise.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Provenance of this row (e.g. tadawul, vendorX, illustrative).

fields.name: last_reviewed
fields.description: Date a human last verified this row.
